passages.heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
passages.text: Hillsborough County is one of the best places in America to live, work, and raise a family.

passages.heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
passages.text: But residents know we face serious challenges.

passages.heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
passages.text: Housing and insurance costs are squeezing working families.

passages.heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
passages.text: Flooding and storm preparedness remain critical concerns.

passages.heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
passages.text: And many residents believe county government has become too focused on process and politics instead of delivering results.

passages.heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
passages.text: After years of the same leadership, voters have an important choice to make.

passages.heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
passages.text: Jackie Toledo is an engineer, mother, small business owner, and former State Representative who has spent her career delivering solutions, managing budgets, and bringing people together to get things done.

passages.heading: Proven Leadership. Real Solutions. A Better Future for Hillsborough County.
passages.text: She has the experience to lead and the determination to deliver.

passages.heading: Endorsements
passages.text: Jackie Toledo is endorsed state and local leaders dedicated to making HIllsborough County a better place to work and live.

passages.heading: Endorsements
passages.text: Blaise Ingoglia - Florida CFO Jackie Toledo is exactly the kind of conservative leader Hillsborough County needs. Jackie knows that government doesn't have a revenue problem; it has a spending problem. She will stand up to the big spenders, cut government waste, and deliver tax cuts. I'm proud to endorse Jackie Toledo because she will make government live within its means.

passages.heading: Endorsements
passages.text: Danny Alvarez - State Representative It is my great pleasure to endorse Jackie Toledo for Hillsborough County Commission. Jackie served as a State Representative for 6 years and her accomplishments are well known. Her solid relationships and working knowledge of the State Legislature will benefit Hillsborough citizens daily. I look forward to working with her when she serves on the County Commission. She is an engineer and a business owner who knows how to solve problems, and she will bring a needed voice to the citizens of Hillsborough County. Hillsborough County needs Jackie!

passages.heading: Endorsements
passages.text: Michael Owen - State Representative Jackie Toledo understands the challenges facing Hillsborough County. Our county needs leaders who will stand up for taxpayers, support law enforcement, encourage responsible growth and bring greater accountability to county government. As an engineer and former state legislator, Jackie brings a practical perspective and valuable experience to the table. Vote Jackie Toledo on November 3rd.

passages.heading: Endorsements
passages.text: Mike Beltran - State Representative Jackie and I represented neighboring districts in the Florida State House, and she always worked super hard for her constituents and to advance common sense policy. I look forward to Jackie applying her expertise in engineering and urban planning to the transportation issues here in Hillsborough.

passages.heading: Endorsements
passages.text: Scott "Coach" Levinson - l am here to enthusiastically endorse Jackie Toledo for Hillsborough County Commissioner District 1. As a life- long citizen of Hillsborough County I have complete confidence that the knowledge, experience, and dedication that Jackie possesses is exactly what is needed to lead our County into an extremely bright and successful future. Please join me and vote for Jackie Toledo on November 3rd.

passages.heading: Join Team Toledo
passages.text: Help Jackie by endorsing Jackie, volunteering, requesting a yard sign, or hosting a fundraiser.

passages.heading: Join Team Toledo
passages.text: Real change only happens when people get involved.

passages.heading: Join Team Toledo
passages.text: Whether you volunteer, host an event, request a yard sign, or make a contribution, your support will help build a stronger future for Hillsborough County.

passages.heading: Donate
passages.text: Jackie Toledo’s campaign is powered by residents who believe Hillsborough County deserves better results and stronger leadership.

passages.heading: Donate
passages.text: Every contribution helps us communicate our message, reach voters, and build a winning grassroots campaign.

passages.heading: Donate
passages.text: Together, we can bring proven leadership and real solutions to the Hillsborough County Commission.

passages.heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
passages.text: Traffic congestion impacts every family, every commuter, and every business.

passages.heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
passages.text: For too long, transportation infrastructure has struggled to keep pace with growth.

passages.heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
passages.text: Jackie will focus on accelerating transportation improvements, reducing congestion, improving traffic flow, and ensuring infrastructure investments are made strategically and efficiently.

passages.heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
passages.text: Explore innovative transportation alternatives.

passages.heading: Fix Traffic and Improve Mobility
passages.text: Residents deserve solutions—not excuses.

passages.heading: Responsible Growth
passages.text: Growth is inevitable. Poor planning is not.

passages.heading: Responsible Growth
passages.text: Jackie believes infrastructure should come before unchecked development and that growth must be managed responsibly. She will work to implement smarter planning, better infrastructure coordination, protect neighborhoods and for greater transparency in development decisions. Work to develop affordable housing options with transportation coordination within our urban core.

passages.heading: Public Safety First
passages.text: Public safety is the most important responsibility of local government.

passages.heading: Public Safety First
passages.text: Jackie will strongly support law enforcement, firefighters, emergency responders, and emergency management professionals who keep our communities safe.

passages.heading: Protect Taxpayers
passages.text: Families are watching every dollar. County government should do the same. Jackie will work to ensure transparency and accountability, discipline in government spending, eliminate waste and prioritize core services. Many challenges face Hillsborough County, and the people deserve a strong advocate for value and results.

passages.heading: Flood Protection and Storm Preparedness
passages.text: Hurricanes and severe weather have demonstrated the importance of preparation.

passages.heading: Flood Protection and Storm Preparedness
passages.text: Jackie will prioritize infrastructure resilience, stormwater improvements, flood mitigation, and emergency preparedness to protect residents and property.

passages.heading: Mother. Engineer. Business Owner. Proven Leader.
passages.text: As a mother of five, she knows the challenges of balancing a budget and raising healthy and strong children.

passages.heading: Mother. Engineer. Business Owner. Proven Leader.
passages.text: As a professional engineer, she understands how infrastructure, transportation, and long-term planning affect our quality of life.

passages.heading: Mother. Engineer. Business Owner. Proven Leader.
passages.text: As a small business owner, she understands budgeting, accountability, and the challenges facing employers and working families.

passages.heading: Mother. Engineer. Business Owner. Proven Leader.
passages.text: As a State Representative, she earned a reputation for effective leadership, bringing people together, and producing meaningful results for the Tampa Bay region.

passages.heading: Mother. Engineer. Business Owner. Proven Leader.
passages.text: Jackie believes public service is about listening to residents, solving problems, and making government work better.

passages.heading: A Record of Results
passages.text: As a member of the Florida House of Representatives, Jackie worked to:

passages.heading: A Record of Results
passages.text: Secure transportation and infrastructure investments

passages.heading: A Record of Results
passages.text: Support workforce development and job creation

passages.heading: A Record of Results
passages.text: Fighting for the most vulnerable, including victims of Human Trafficking and those suffering from Mental Health issues

passages.heading: A Record of Results
passages.text: Delivered resources that benefited Hillsborough County families

passages.heading: A Record of Results
passages.text: She understands that leadership is measured by outcomes—not intentions.

passages.heading: Why I’m Running
passages.text: “For too long, county leaders have talked about the same problems while residents continue to face gridlocked roads, affordability challenges, flooding, and concerns about public safety. The commission needs leaders who will ask tough questions, demand accountability, and focus on delivering results rather than expanding bureaucracy.”
